title: Cultivating Pluralism In Algorithmic Monoculture: The Community Alignment Dataset
reasoning: The paper uses the Inglehart-Welzel (IW) dimensions to evaluate LLM alignment, specifically measuring preferences along the 'secular-rational vs. traditional' axis. This axis directly contrasts reason and social change with religious and traditional beliefs. Furthermore, the paper aims to address cultural and political divides in LLM responses.
